harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Held curl at its current version on node1 using dnf versionlock, verified a full system update left curl untouched while other packages (kernel, openssh, openssl, systemd, etc.) upgraded, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, restarted node1, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified curl and the versionlock entry survived the reboot.
actions_performed: Captured baseline curl version (curl-7.76.1-40.el9) on node1
Installed python3-dnf-plugin-versionlock on node1
Added a dnf versionlock entry for curl (curl-0:7.76.1-40.el9.*)
Ran a full 'dnf update -y' system update on node1 to exercise the requirement
Verified curl version was unchanged post-update while many other packages (kernel, openssh, openssl, systemd, etc.) were upgraded
Verified versionlock.list persisted the lock entry on disk
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline (curl held, functional, versionlock active)
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (single node, ack returned via stream closing before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Confirmed boot_id changed from 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 to bb3a7c3b-78c8-48f3-837c-62277a2fd01b, proving an actual restart occurred
Post-restart verified curl version unchanged and versionlock entry still present/active

evidence.requirement: curl held at current version before a system update (baseline capture)
evidence.summary: Captured curl-7.76.1-40.el9 baseline, installed versionlock plugin, added lock for curl, confirmed lock listed.

evidence.requirement: System update leaves curl at its held version
evidence.summary: Ran full 'dnf update -y'; many packages (kernel, openssh, openssl, systemd, etc.) upgraded, but curl remained curl-7.76.1-40.el9.x86_64 post-update; versionlock.list on disk still contains the curl lock entry.

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline and boot identity for node1
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 and confirmed curl functional and versionlock active before restart.
Issued 'systemctl reboot' on node1; command stream closed as the node went down, acknowledging the restart was accepted.

evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
evidence.summary: Polled node1 (two timeouts while down) until exec access returned with new boot_id bb3a7c3b-78c8-48f3-837c-62277a2fd01b, differing from the pre-restart boot_id, proving an actual reboot.

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of curl version hold on node1
evidence.summary: After reboot, curl remained curl-7.76.1-40.el9.x86_64 and the versionlock entry for curl persisted in /etc/dnf/plugins/versionlock.list.

attempts.summary: Held curl at its current version on node1 using dnf versionlock, verified a full system update left curl untouched while other packages (kernel, openssh, openssl, systemd, etc.) upgraded, then completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline, restarted node1, confirmed the boot_id changed, and re-verified curl and the versionlock entry survived the reboot.
